correctness.rationale: The invariant-simplex orbit model is exact because barycentric weights on each color orbit must agree. When a color is fixed, every nonsingleton orbit vertex is dominated by the corresponding fixed-color vertex at the same base vertex, giving a simplicial collapse to Ind(G times K_f); when none is fixed, the graph equals the independent-clone blowup. Reduced Lefschetz numbers equal reduced Euler characteristics after equivariant subdivision. The published 2023 theorem concentrates homology in odd degree 2ell-1 and gives rank B_ell(n)=3(n-1)^ell+(-1)^ell(n-1); for zero fixed colors an exact 2-by-2 transfer matrix yields B_ell(0)=2(-1)^ell. No finite check is used as a universal proof. A standalone verifier confirms 192 examples by graph quotient and 11504 invariant original faces for direct signed traces.

value.rationale: The result classifies a genuine rational S_n-module for every positive cycle parameter and every n>=2, not merely a Betti number. The resulting character polynomial is independent of the nontrivial color-cycle structure, a meaningful equivariant rigidity fact; the fixed-point graph fold is valid for arbitrary finite simple base graphs. These additional group-action invariants cannot be inferred from the known nonequivariant sphere multiplicities.
